# Primed Grocery List - Copilot Instructions

## Release Status
The app has not been publicly released yet. The current storage schema version is v1 (`shopping_lists_v1`). Only increment the schema version (e.g. to `_v2`) when the persisted data format actually changes in a breaking way — not for routine refactors or feature additions.

## User Instructions
- User is new to Dart/Flutter, so code should be clear and well commented.

- Keep the application refactored to improve readability, maintainability, and performance.

- Focus on best practices for Flutter development, such as using state management solutions (e.g., Provider, Riverpod) and optimizing widget rebuilds.

- Ensure feature requests are tested and well categorized (eg UI, state management).
